about.title: Why this platform was created
about.subtitle: Genesis, field observations, and digital transformation of the internship lifecycle at STEG.
about.initialContextLead: Prior to the creation of this platform, internship management at STEG relied on traditional manual workflows that created major operational hurdles:
about.pain1Desc: Students had to physically visit regional district offices to submit paper files with no prior certainty of seat availability.
about.pain2Desc: Applications, assignment letters, and certificates moved via hard copies, causing significant administrative delays and file loss risks.
about.pain3Desc: Neither students nor their academic institutions had any tool to monitor the exact progress or review stage of submitted files.
about.pain4Desc: Once on-site, tracking daily tasks, journals, and project milestones lacked a modern, standardized digital medium with STEG mentors.
about.solutionLead: STEG established a complete 3-tier interconnected platform to seamlessly cover every stage of the lifecycle:
about.facet1Desc: This public portal enables transparent discovery, guided multi-step applications, automatic date classification, and direct tracking.
about.facet2Desc: A dedicated workspace for HR coordinators and district leads to review dossiers, assign supervisors, and approve conventions.
about.facet3Desc: The student's mobile app for daily task tracking, weekly milestone logs, deliverable uploads, and mentor feedback.
about.videoSectionDesc: Watch how modern digital transformation enhances the STEG internship journey.
about.impactCandidateDesc: Complete autonomy, 24/7 online submission, instant rule classification, and tamper-proof certificates.
about.impactUniversityDesc: High visibility into student assignments, formal convention handling, and strict academic compliance.
about.impactStegDesc: Paper elimination, bulletproof audit logs, secure archiving, and premier pedagogical mentoring.
about.ctaBannerTitle: Have a project or an internship agreement?
about.ctaBannerDesc: Submit your application right now and receive personalised follow-up at every step.
about.imageCaption: Historical paper processes: slowness, travel and administrative overload.
about.videoFallback: Your browser does not support video playback.

history.title: STEG: Past, Present, and Future
history.subtitle: Founded in 1962, over 60 years of nationwide electrification, gas infrastructure development, and commitment to renewable energy transition.
history.foundationTitle: The Birth of a National Utility (1962)
history.foundationP1: On the eve of independence, electricity operations in Tunisia were fragmented across seven private concessionary companies supplying main regions, with a total installed capacity of nearly 100 MW and an output of approximately 240 GWh.
history.foundationP2: On April 3, 1962, via Law No. 62-8, the Tunisian State established the Société Tunisienne de l'Electricité et du Gaz (STEG), entrusting it with the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity and natural gas nationwide.
history.foundationP3: Faced with the massive challenge of powering a growing nation with limited initial energy resources, STEG accomplished nationwide electrification and full grid interconnection.
history.statsLead: Authoritative historical benchmarks showcasing the dedication of STEG engineers and staff across Tunisia:
history.stat2Detail: Rose from 6% to 99.5% across all rural provinces
history.stat3Detail: From 100 MW in 1962 to 5,982 MW in 2023
history.mission1Desc: Electricity generation from thermal, hydroelectric, wind, and solar sources, along with Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) production.
history.mission2Desc: Operation and expansion of high-voltage grids and substations, and master management of the national natural gas pipeline infrastructure.
history.mission3Desc: Grid development and distribution across medium and low-voltage networks, providing reliable electricity and gas to over 5.5M households and businesses.
history.transitionDesc: STEG actively pioneers renewable energy through wind farms, solar PV power stations, and geothermal research to secure Tunisia's sustainable future.
history.organigrammeDesc: Official organizational chart of STEG reflecting corporate governance, directorates general, and regional operations.
history.organigrammeCaption: Official Organizational Chart of the Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas
history.energyDesc: Sustained development of wind farms and photovoltaic plants.
history.geoDesc: Advanced research and efficient management of gas and thermal resources.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.faqQuestion1: How do I create an account?
faq.faqAnswer1: Click Apply and follow the registration steps.
faq.faqQuestion2: How is the internship type determined?
faq.faqAnswer2: The type is automatically calculated from start and end dates.
faq.faqAnswer3: Two PDFs are mandatory: internship assignment letter and CIN copy.
faq.faqQuestion4: Can the observation internship be optional?
faq.faqAnswer4: Yes, for observation the candidate chooses. For perfectionnement and PFE, it is mandatory.
faq.faqAnswer5: 50 TND per completed month, capped at 3 months (150 TND maximum).
faq.faqQuestion6: How does the Finance review work?
faq.faqAnswer6: The supervisor completes the dossier, Finance reviews and decides to approve or reject.
faq.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about the process, eligibility criteria and validation of your STEG internship.
faq.ctaDesc: Our supervision teams and technical support are listening.
